mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment becomes increasingly accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO increased in the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), aggressive rate hikes to combat inflation reduce equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increased over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0% of its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0% of 12-month MA, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
